text: Select one economically useful festival workflow for Aimparency's first pilot
description: Use Wilde Möhre as the first discovery case, without changing safety-critical live operations before the final festival. In one owner/operator conversation, identify a bounded recurring workflow with a named owner, current artifacts, measurable baseline, decision rights, exclusions, and willingness to pay for a diagnostic. Rank candidate workflows by economic pain, recurrence, reversibility, data availability, and reusable Aimparency capability. Initial recommendation: post-festival closeout and institutional-memory graph. Success is permission to inspect one real workflow and its evidence—not enthusiasm for AI.
